meta.title: PolyCrystal Blender bridge
meta.description: Load CIF/POSCAR/LAMMPS polymer crystals through an isolated Python PBC sidecar and co-edit them live in a Blender 4.2+ GUI. Provides polycrystal_env, polycrystal_load, polycrystal_modify, polycrystal_inspect and polycrystal_render tools. Never bundles Blender; never pollutes Blender's Python.
